title: antholyza gawleri
intro: Antholyza gawleri, commonly known as Red Coral Pea, is a plant species native to Australia, known for its unique red and yellow flowers. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, as well as therapeutic actions like reducing pain and anxiety. The bioactive constituents present in Antholyza gawleri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential therapeutic applications of this plant.
